facts.fact: SATCP says the Malawi Revenue Authority is upgrading, testing and piloting ASYCUDA World from version 4.3.3 to 4.4.0, to complete by September 2025, with a scanner integration with ASYCUDA operational.

MWI.note: The single window had only a pilot launch on 19 May 2025 and is work in progress; the tripartite customs data exchange is planned from June 2025.
Only the Malawi Revenue Authority's own disaster recovery data centre is named, not stated as for hire.
